residual_risks: Offline numerical admission requires ANCHORED trusted time; on devices where only floor/unmeasured time is available the client returns retryable `unavailable` rather than using the cached policy (conservative by design, matches evaluateLease()).

Recovery of an already-admitted attempt (reserve_pending after process death) re-sends the reservation without re-reading the policy; that path never publishes a new numerical result (it is held/cancelled) and the server re-checks release authority at reservation time, so no numerical output can be produced without an active policy.

Every scoring run now performs one extra GET /v1/analysis/release-policy before reserving; the server route is cached/rate-limited per existing edge policy, and a cached verified policy is not used to short-circuit the online read (server-first, cache only as offline fallback).

The Edge canonicaliser is mirrored, not shared (Deno vs RN bundles); parity is pinned by the fixture digest test (0ded0fac…ade89) and the RFC 8785 ordering/number/string cases, so future canonicalDigest.ts changes must be mirrored here.

Only a verified ACTIVE policy is cached: record <= 192 KiB, lifetime <= TRUSTED_TIME_LEASE_MAX_MS, bound to owner+API origin by digest and stored under owner-scoped kv key `analysis.release-policy:<owner>` (namespace added to OWNER_SCOPED_KV_NAMESPACES so purgeOwnerData()/account deletion removes it per owner). Offline admission only for a cached verified policy inside its validity window under anchored trusted time (evaluateLease); floor/none/rollback/unmeasured => unavailable.
